verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes has no dedicated batch or bulk API. Bulk work is possible indirectly: a single connection multiplexes SDK calls to avoid subrequest limits when running many concurrent operations (docs-17), and shell commands via exec() can act on many files at once (docs-1, docs-43). Smaller helpers include recursive mkdir (docs-25) and glob-filtered watching (docs-26). Missing for 10: a first-class batch or bulk-operation API (e.g., multi-file read/write or fan-out across many sandboxes), documented bulk workflows or examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
